changeSet.author: claude (P4-11)
changeSet.comment: Browse filters by language pair without direction (decided 2026-10-03): pair=DE-TR must return DE->TR and TR->DE listings. lang_pair stores both codes in alphabetical order (DE-TR for either direction), so the filter is one indexed lang_pair IN (...) rather than an OR over both directions. The application derives it from from_lang/to_lang on every write (LanguagePairUtils); this backfills existing rows the same way. COLLATE "C" orders by code point, matching Java's String.compareTo - a locale collation could order some pair differently and leave it unmatched. Codes are already uppercase (2026/09/27-04). Added nullable, backfilled, then made NOT NULL, because addColumn with NOT NULL fails on a non-empty table.

sql.sql: UPDATE dictionary_stats SET lang_pair = LEAST(from_lang COLLATE "C", to_lang COLLATE "C") || '-' || GREATEST(from_lang COLLATE "C", to_lang COLLATE "C");
